parsing_notes: Parsed the 'Distributions' worksheet of the issuer's Data Download workbook. The file is SpreadsheetML XML despite the .xls extension; strict XML parsing fails on one unescaped '&' in a URL inside the Disclaimers sheet, so bare '&' were escaped to '&' before parsing (no data cells affected). amount = 'Total Distribution' per share in USD, which equals Income + ST Cap Gains + LT Cap Gains + Return of Capital on every row (max abs diff 0). All 289 rows are cash distributions with an ex-date and payable date; there are no stock splits, no undistributed/reinvested capital gains rows, and no return-of-capital rows. Exactly one row has a non-zero capital-gain component: ex 2012-12-03 (LT Cap Gains 0.009392 on total 0.276969), included since it was paid in cash. Ex-dates are unique; no summing across duplicate ex-dates was needed. Dates were 'Mon DD, YYYY' strings converted to YYYY-MM-DD. Every January has no ex-date and every December has two (a first-business-day monthly distribution plus a mid/late-December year-end distribution); this is iShares' standard schedule, not a gap. Coverage requested was through 2026-07-17; the file keeps the full history as published, which includes 2 ex-dates after that cutoff (2026-08-03, 2026-09-01). The 2026-09-01 record (payable 2026-09-04) was declared but not yet paid at capture time. Fund inception 2002-07-22 (per issuer page); first distribution ex-date 2002-09-03.
